name: look
description: Read what the person sees now: bench or lab mode, the bench snapshot (parts, wires, nets, findings, lesson), the lab snapshot when a lab is open (items, reports, mistakes, the experiment step), the selection, the co-build session and recent observations. Call it before answering about the bench.

name: list_targets
description: List what point_at can point at: lab item ids and kinds when a lab is open, else bench part refdes and pins as <refdes>.<pin>.

name: point_at
description: Show a callout bubble with a leader line from an item to a short text, such as 'use this one'. At most 3 at once; the oldest goes.

target.description: A lab item id or kind (bunsen-burner), a bench part refdes (R1, LED1) or a pin as <refdes>.<pin> (U1.D13).

text.description: A few words in the person's language.

tone.description: info (default), do (an action to take) or warn.

name: show_text
description: Show text in the speech bubble near the person, with optional reply chips the person can press.

name: clear_callouts
description: Remove every callout bubble.

name: propose_build
description: Start 'Build it with me': the co-builder proposes the first step of a template build as a ghost on the bench. Nothing changes until the person accepts. Only templates can be built today (for example Blink); a free request returns ok false.

request.description: What to build, in the person's words (help me build blink).

name: accept_step
description: Perform the proposed co-build step (the person said yes). Set all to do every remaining step; for several steps or going back, use go_to_step.

name: reject_step
description: Skip the proposed co-build step for the rest of the session.

name: undo_step
description: Take back the co-builder's last performed step.

name: go_to_step
description: Move the running co-build (Build it with me, or propose_edit) several steps at once, in one call: forward performs each step in turn (shown, then done), back takes the co-builder's steps back. Use it whenever the person asks for more than one step: do all of them or finish (to end), go back to the start or start over (to start), go to step N (step), or the next N or back N steps (by). Give exactly one of to, step or by. It returns at once and the steps keep running on the bench; stop_steps stops them where they are.

to.description: start: take every co-builder step back. end: do every remaining step.

step.description: The step to show next, counted from 1 (step 1 is the start).

by.description: Steps to move: positive goes forward, negative goes back.

name: stop_steps
description: Stop a run of steps (go_to_step, or accept_step with all) at the step it has reached, when the person says stop, wait or pause.

name: propose_edit
description: Show bench changes as ghosts the person can follow by hand, or that you perform when they say yes (accept_step; all for every step). Use it to move, place, turn, pull or remove a part, or to add or remove a wire, when the person asks you to do it or to show them how. Nothing changes until they accept or do it themselves; a step they do by hand counts as done and the next is shown. Name parts by refdes (LED1), pins as REF.PIN (U1.D13, U1.5V), holes like e12; look first. Edits that cannot be done come back in unreachable with the reason.

summary.description: One short line for the card, in the person's language (Move the LED next to the resistor).

steps.description: The edits, in order; later ones may use what earlier ones make.

action.description: move or place: first leg into hole to. turn: to deg. pull: out of its holes. wire or unwire: between from and to.

part.description: Refdes of a bench part (LED1); for place, a part definition ref (core.led-5mm).

to.description: move, place: a hole (e12). wire, unwire: the second end, a hole or REF.PIN.

from.description: wire, unwire: the first end (U1.D13 or a10).

reason.description: Why, in one short sentence in the person's language.

name: open_lab
description: Lay out a training lab on the bench (the circuit bench is hidden, never changed). Works from anywhere: it leaves the drone, room size, Home or another lab first.

name: leave_lab
description: Leave the lab and bring back the circuit bench.

name: start_experiment
description: Start a guided experiment with its own kit. In exam mode the tutor is silent and hints and acting tools are refused.

name: set_lab_control
description: Work a lab item's control for the person (gas, light, collar, power ...), through the lab store so the tutor sees it. Refused in an exam.

action.description: One of the item's actions (look shows the kinds; bunsen-burner: gas, light, collar).

value.description: Optional value; numbers and true/false are converted.

name: request_item
description: Put equipment on the lab bench by kind or name. Equipment the lab has no model of comes as a labelled stand-in box (placeholder true): say so. Refused in an exam.

name: next_step_hint
description: The current experiment or lesson step and its hint, with a callout on the item it is about. Refused in an exam.

name: bench_actions
description: List the build actions edit_bench can run on the circuit bench, each with its arguments and what it does.

name: edit_bench
description: Change the circuit on the bench with one build action (add, move, seat, pull, turn or remove a part; add, move, recolour or remove a wire). Applied at once as one change the person can undo. Call bench_actions for the argument shapes. Name parts by refdes (LED1) or id. Use it when the person asks for a change; say what you changed.

args_json.description: The action's arguments as a JSON object, e.g. {"part":"LED1","step":1} for turnPart or {"part":"RES1"} for removePart.

name: undo
description: Take back the last change: on the circuit bench the person's or your own last edit or fix, in a lab the last change to a lab item, else the co-builder's last step. Refused in an exam.

times.description: How many changes to take back, 1 to 10 (default 1).

name: redo
description: Put back a change that undo took back on the circuit bench.

name: explain_problems
description: Check what is wrong: on the circuit bench the simulator's circuit check (no run needed) and the last run's findings, each with a title, why it is a problem, how to fix it and the fixes that can be applied; in a lab the tutor's active mistakes. Shows callouts on the parts unless point is false. Refused in an exam.

point.description: Show callouts on what each problem is about (default true).

name: apply_fix
description: Apply a problem's ready-made fix from explain_problems (one undoable change each), or every safe fix at once. Only when the person agrees.

problem.description: The problem's number n from explain_problems (default 1).

fix.description: Which of its fixes, by n (default the first that can be applied).

all_safe.description: Apply every fix marked safe instead.

name: run_circuit
description: Control the circuit simulation on the bench, like its rail buttons: run (from the circuit as it is now), pause, step a paused run by ms, stop, or restart from the beginning. Run-time problems show in explain_problems after a pause or the end.

name: go_to
description: Go anywhere in the app from wherever the person is, leaving what is open first: a lab (chemistry, physics, electrical, signals and systems), the drone, the workbench, room size, Home, a template (blink, button, servo, piano, robot …) or a saved project, by name. Use it for 'go to', 'open', 'switch to', 'take me to'.

where.description: The place, lab, template or project in the person's words, e.g. 'signals lab', 'drone', 'servo', 'workbench'.

name: list_controls
description: List every button in the menu that other parts of the app offer (Build it with me, Voice, see-through, each lab, leave the lab, …), with on or off for a switch, and where the person is now.

name: use_control
description: Press one of the menu's buttons from list_controls, by id or name (a switch flips).

name: set_mode
description: Switch the companion between assist mode (explain, point and suggest only) and build mode (it may change things). In assist mode this is the only action allowed: use it when the person asks to switch to build mode.
